bio.text: Jeff McLaughlin of Guntersville, a former state representative, is the Democratic nominee for Alabama attorney general in 2026.
According to his campaign website, he was born in Decatur, raised in Guntersville, was a schoolteacher before becoming a lawyer, and has practiced law in Guntersville for more than thirty years.
He represented Marshall County in the Alabama House of Representatives for ten years, according to his campaign.
His campaign says he graduated from Birmingham-Southern College and Harvard Law School.
